rootDecoder.name: _0x374d
rootDecoder.kind: top level FunctionDeclaration, reassigns itself on first call
rootDecoder.semantics: index minus 297 selects a slot in the string array; the second argument is the per string key used by the inline base64 decode

aliases.note: each is a local `var X = <alias|_0x374d>` chain that resolves to the same global function, so a call site of any alias has the same value as _0x374d with the same arguments

rotation.caution: the detected span is large, so it is a coarse block match and NOT proof of a per call rotation; the value table was read after the page finished loading, so it reflects the final array state

literalsOnly: every collected site passes exactly two literal arguments; sites with non literal arguments were not collected and are not part of the reference
limitations: values were read after load, so a decoder that changed the array later would make earlier calls differ; no evidence of that was observed but it was not separately excluded
the reference covers 823 of the call sites of these aliases; it does not claim to cover every decoder call in the bundle
